invariants.statement: Apps import shared domain only via package names; no relative deep-imports into packages/ and no app → app imports.
Secrets, .env files, and private key material must not be committed.
Do not weaken architecture, security, or CI gates to make a build pass; change the authority named in authority-map.json instead of hand-editing generated facts.
Protected staging and main branches require Architecture, Lint, Security, and Build checks; main review evidence must apply to the latest push and all threads must be resolved.
Deploy and rollback cannot report success without a validated immutable release manifest, configured adapter, and durable non-stub evidence.
Product repositories classify tenant propagation, durable acknowledgement, single-source-of-truth, and external-authority safeguards before adoption is accepted.
